milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the open-front workshop and visually locate the fletching table. The fletching table is placed at spawn-relative (6, 1, 5) inside the building. max_distance=16 allows detection from the building entrance or interior, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the block, modeling 'the player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining fully-grown beetroot crops (age=3) drops 'beetroot' items (singular, not 'beetroots') into the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory and there is no other source of beetroot in the scene, so having at least 1 beetroot confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because the item reliably ending up in inventory is the most direct signal.
